title: Imagery and Illustration
summary: Imagery should add task information, context or brand meaning; decorative images carry no information.

MUST.text: Use representative imagery that matches the actual product/variant; provide equivalent alt text for informative images.
Use empty alt (alt="") for purely decorative images.
Serve responsive images (srcset/sizes) in modern formats (WebP/AVIF) with explicit dimensions to prevent layout shift.

SHOULD.text: Lazy-load below-the-fold images; prioritize LCP image.
Preserve meaning when cropping; use object-fit and defined aspect ratios.
Provide captions or context for complex informative images.

AVOID.text: Stock imagery as fake evidence or filler.
Images that misrepresent the product or obscure text.
Unbounded image sizes causing CLS or slow loads.

DECIDE.decision: Support task or brand, not filler

EXAMPLE.good: "Product image shows exact color/size; alt describes variant."

FAILURE_MODES: Misleading imagery erodes trust and causes returns.
Missing or wrong alt text blocks screen reader users.
Unoptimized images hurt performance and CLS.
Decorative images announced as content create noise.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group Images as Information
